cmd: id; getent group research; id alice; id bob; which setfacl getfacl; ls -ld /srv 2>/dev/null

mkdir -p /srv/shared && chown root:research /srv/shared && chmod 2770 /srv/shared && \
setfacl -m g:research:rwx,u:alice:rwx,u:bob:rwx,o::---,m::rwx /srv/shared && \
setfacl -d -m g:research:rwx,u:ali

su -s /bin/bash alice -c 'touch /srv/shared/alicefile && mkdir /srv/shared/alice_dir && touch /srv/shared/alice_dir/nested' && \
su -s /bin/bash bob -c 'cat /srv/shared/alicefile && echo bob-write >>

grep -Ev '^(root|alice|bob):' /etc/passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65000 {print $1}' | head -3; \
OTHER=$(grep -Ev '^(root|alice|bob):' /etc/passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65000 {print $1; exit}');

rm -rf /srv/shared/alicefile /srv/shared/bobfile /srv/shared/alice_dir && \
ls -la /srv/shared && echo '--- final state ---' && ls -ld /srv/shared && getfacl -p /srv/shared
